title: Demon seed (talent)

source.excerpt:
589: newTalent{
590: 	name = "Demon Seed",
591: 	type = {"corruption/demonic-pact", 1},
592: 	require = {
593: 		stat = { mag=function(level) return 12 + (level-1) * 2 end },
594: 		level = function(level) return 0 + (level-1) * 6  end,
595: 	},
596: 	points = 5,
597: 	vim = 5,
598: 	stamina = 8,
599: 	cooldown = 8,
600: 	range = 1,
601: 	requires_target = true,
602: 	tactical = { ATTACK = 2, DISABLE = { daze = 1 } },
603: 	getDam = function(self, t) return self:combatTalentWeaponDamage(t, 0.6, 1.4, self:getTalentLevel(self.T_SHIELD_EXPERTISE)), self:combatTalentWeaponDamage(t, 0.6, 1.6) end,
604: 	getDazeDuration = function(self, t) return math.floor(self:combatTalentScale(t, 2.5, 4.5)) end,
605: 	getHeal = function(self, t) return math.floor(self:combatTalentScale(t, 10, 30)) end,
606: 	on_pre_use = function(self, t, silent) if not self:hasShield() then if not silent then game.logPlayer(self, "You require a weapon and a shield to use this talent.") end return false end return true end,
607: 	createSeed = createSeed,
608: 	demon_seeds_tiers = demon_seeds_tiers,
609: 	demon_seeds_effects = demon_seeds_effects,
610: 	callbackOnWearTinker = seed_gfx_update,
611: 	callbackOnTakeoffTinker = seed_gfx_update,
612: 	on_learn = function(self, t)
613: 		local lvl = self:getTalentLevelRaw(t)
614: 		if lvl == 1 then
615: 			self.can_tinker = self.can_tinker or {}
616: 			self.can_tinker["demon-seed"] = 1
617: 			self.tinker_restrict_slots = { MAINHAND=1 }
618: 		end
619: 	end,
620: 	on_unlearn = function(self, t)
621: 		local lvl = self:getTalentLevelRaw(t)
622: 		if lvl == 0 then
623: 			self.can_tinker["demon-seed"] = nil
624: 			self.tinker_restrict_slots.MAINHAND = nil
625: 		end
626: 	end,
627: 	action = function(self, t)
628: 		if not seeds_list_hooked then
629: 			seeds_list_hooked = true
630: 			self:triggerHook{"DemonicPact:updateSeedsList", demon_seeds_tiers=t.demon_seeds_tiers, demon_seeds_effects=demon_seeds_effects}
631: 		end
632: 
633: 		local shield, shield_combat = self:hasShield()
634: 		if not shield then return nil end
635: 
636: 		local tg = {type="hit", range=1}
637: 		local x, y, target = self:getTarget(tg)
638: 		if not x or not y or not target then return nil end
639: 		if core.fov.distance(self.x, self.y, x, y) > 1 then return nil end
640: 
641: 		local shielddam, weapondam = t.getDam(self, t)
642: 
643: 		local hit = self:attackTarget(target, DamageType.BLIGHT, weapondam, true)
644: 
645: 		if hit then
646: 			-- We dont want the player to end up with a demon seed!
647: 			local chance = 100
648: 			if target.rank <= 2 then chance = 5
649: 			elseif target.rank <= 3 then chance = 20
650: 			elseif target.rank <= 3.5 then chance = 50
651: 			end
652: 			if config.settings.cheat then chance = 100 end
653: 
654: 			-- First time it always works
655: 			if not self:attr("used_demon_seed") then chance = 100 end
656: 
657: 			if self.player and not target.demonic_summon and target.exp_worth > 0 and not game.party:hasMember(target) then
658: 				if target.dead then
659: 					if rng.percent(chance) then
660: 						createSeed(self, t, target, not self:attr("used_demon_seed"))
661: 						game.level.map:particleEmitter(x, y, tg.radius, "circle", {oversize=0.7, a=90, limit_life=8, shader=true, appear=8, speed=2, img="blood_circle", radius=self:getTalentRadius(t)})
662: 						self:attr("used_demon_seed", 1)
663: 					end
664: 				else
665: 					target:setEffect(target.EFF_DEMON_SEED, 1, {src=self, power=self:getTalentLevel(t), chance=chance, force_first=not self:attr("used_demon_seed")})
666: 					game.level.map:particleEmitter(x, y, tg.radius, "circle", {oversize=0.7, a=90, limit_life=8, shader=true, appear=8, speed=2, img="blood_circle", radius=self:getTalentRadius(t)})
667: 					self:attr("used_demon_seed", 1)
668: 				end
669: 			end
670: 
671: 			local speed, hit2 = self:attackTargetWith(target, shield_combat, nil, shielddam) 
672: 			if hit2 and target:canBe("stun") then target:setEffect(target.EFF_DAZED, t.getDazeDuration(self, t), {apply_power=self:combatSpellpower()}) end
673: 		end
674: 
675: 		game.level.map:particleEmitter(x, y, 1, "circle", {shader=true, oversize=1, a=120, appear=8, limit_life=14, speed=0, base_rot=180, img="demon_seed", radius=0})
676: 
677: 		return true
678: 	end,
679: 	info = function(self, t)
680: 		local _, color_normal = self:textRank(2)
681: 		local _, color_elite = self:textRank(3)
682: 		local _, color_rare = self:textRank(3.2)
683: 		local _, color_unique = self:textRank(3.5)
684: 		local _, color_boss = self:textRank(4)
685: 
686: 		local shield, weapon = t.getDam(self, t)
687: 		return ([[Strike a blow with your weapon for %d%% blight damage.
688: 		If the attack hits a demonic seed tries to take hold inside your foe and you follow up with a shield strike dealing %d%% damage and dazing your target for %d turns.
689: 		
690: 		The seed requires a powerful host to nourish it and can only take hold in creatures that are worth experience and that are not summoned demons.
691: 		The chance for the seed to take hold is based on the creatures rank:
692: 		%sNormal#LAST#:  5%%
693: 		%sElite#LAST#:  20%%
694: 		%sRare#LAST# or %sUnique#LAST#:  50%%
695: 		%sBoss#LAST#:  100%%
696: 		When the host dies the seed fills with the vim of the dying creature and turns into a specific demon seed that can be used to summon that demon.
697: 		If you already have a seed of the same time in your inventory or equipment it will instead increase its level if the host was of higher level than the seed and the demon inside will regenerate %d%% health and resurrect if it was dead.
698: 
699: 		Higher talent levels allow for more powerful demon types.
700: 		Implanting a seed into unique demons, if successful, will always try to grant a seed of that type, if available.]])
701: 		:tformat(weapon * 100, shield * 100, t.getDazeDuration(self, t), color_normal, color_elite, color_rare, color_unique, color_boss, t:_getHeal(self))
702: 	end,
703: }
